content:
## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `addpipe32` (32-bit registered adder: y = a + b (mod 2^32)) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module addpipe32 (
    input  wire        clk,
    input  wire        rst_n,
    input  wire        valid_i,
    input  wire [31:0] a_i,
    input  wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg         valid_o,
    output reg  [31:0] y_o
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o     <= 32'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;

        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= a_i + b_i;
    end
end

endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 746.13 um^2, WNS 7.48722 ns, score 74.12607.
estimate_ppa on this RTL returns area 671.384 um^2, WNS 7.57073 ns, estimated score 75.035916 (estimates omit tap cells, buffering and wiring, so compare estimates with estimates).

## Rules
- One module of synthesizable Verilog-2005 (no helper modules or instances; the equivalence checker compares flat modules). The module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: simulate, prove_equivalence, estimate_ppa, place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: Based on extensive experimentation, I tested several alternative adder architectures (explicit ripple-carry, carry-select, Kogge-Stone parallel-prefix) as well as equivalent rephrasings of the register/reset logic. All rephrasings that preserved the same high-level semantics synthesized to the *identical* netlist (confirming Yosys/ABC already canonicalizes them). The explicit "smarter" adder architectures (carry-select, Kogge-Stone) actually performed *worse* than the plain `a_i + b_i` in both area and timing, and a naive hand-written ripple-carry chain was much smaller but far slower (killing the score, since WNS is weighted 10x per ns vs 0.001 per µm² for area). This shows Yosys's default arithmetic synthesis for `+` already produces a near-Pareto-optimal structure for this flow, and no equivalent Verilog-2005 rewrite improved on it. The best verified result remains the original specification RTL itself: area 746.13 µm², WNS 7.48722 ns, score 74.12607 (confirmed via place_and_route in this session).

input.summary: Explored multiple rewrites of addpipe32 (explicit ripple-carry full-adder chain, 8-bit block carry-select adder, full Kogge-Stone parallel-prefix adder, and several equivalent phrasings of the reset/hold mux logic) and evaluated them with estimate_ppa before committing to the expensive place_and_route flow. All functionally-equivalent rephrasings of the register/mux logic synthesized to the exact same netlist as the original (confirmed via identical area/WNS estimates), showing Yosys/ABC already canonicalizes these forms. The "smarter" adder architectures (carry-select, Kogge-Stone) were actually worse than the reference on both area and delay after ABC's own optimization, and a naive explicit ripple-carry adder was much smaller but drastically slower, hurting the score badly since WNS is weighted 10x per ns versus 0.001 per µm² of area. This indicates the default `a_i + b_i` synthesis already produces a near-optimal structure for this specific PPA objective and flow. Formal equivalence (prove_equivalence: PROVEN) and simulation (PASS) were verified for the carry-select variant tried, and place_and_route was run on the original specification RTL, reproducing the given baseline metrics exactly (area 746.13 µm², WNS 7.48722 ns, score 74.12607). No variant beat this baseline, so it is submitted as the final best verified result.
